_doc: Authenticator setup (all values are fake). The secret, the otpauth URI and the recovery codes appear in exactly these answers and never again: me carries only mfa {totp, email, recoveryCodesLeft}. Setup asks the password in a full session (not in an enrolment session); a wrong code is 403 code_invalid (never 401). Confirm in an enrolment session makes that same token a full session.
